exact_audit.objective: E[e^2]+4(E[e])^2 exactly on the finite empirical audit-image pool

monte_carlo_secondary.objective: 2048 sampled iid image sets of size five from the same audit pool

statistical_unit: eight seed aggregates; first average candidates within seed/task/cell, then four fixed task banks within seed
interpretation_limit: descriptive intervals over seed aggregates; source pools may overlap and four task banks are repeated fixed tasks, not independent seeds

topology.fingerprint_definition: Exact SHA-256 of packed binary mask; effective state fingerprint hashes contiguous exact tensors (W*M, bias, readout, per-image offset), including dtype and shape.
topology.interpretation: A solution fit is a separately initialized/trained row; repeated mask topologies remain separate fits. Exact effective-state hashes are checked separately.

context_split.interpretation: Train/held-out is a local 80/20 teacher split per task and seed. Some binary masks recur across the split; no exact effective-state fingerprint (W*M,bias,readout,offset) recurs. Held-out teachers are excluded from pooled context; this is not a generator held-out reconstruction evaluation.

paired_gap_sign: sparse audit NMSE minus dense audit NMSE for the same task and replica; negative favors sparse
context_quality_nonuse: quality, audit NMSE, and candidate_recipe are not context inputs; pooled contexts use train teachers only
source_population_objective: E[e^2]+4(E[e])^2, e=g(x)-c[digit]; exactly E[(sum_5 e_i)^2/5] for iid sets of size 5
audit_nmse_definition: Primary: exact E[e^2]+4(E[e])^2 on the finite 3000-image empirical audit population, equivalent to E[(sum_5 e_i)^2/5] for iid sampling from that pool. Secondary: 2048 sampled sets of size five.

audit_artifact_roles.secondary_mc: per-seed audit_replay.pt and shard audit_nmse vectors

selection_rule: all candidates retained; no audit-score filtering or candidate winner selection
historical_old_bank_comparison_note: not matched/paired: old source data and training protocol (~20% of source pool) differed from this mixed-density population-fit bank

solver_selection.selection: terminal query loss; plateau reported separately, no plateau-based quality filtering

solver_selection_provenance.preliminary_proposal: bank_v3_pilot/selection.json proposes LR/L2 under stochastic fresh-set learning, decay2000,8000steps
solver_selection_provenance.actual_production_call: Frozen source_snapshot/rebuilt_bank_run.py reads LR/L2 from bank_v3_pilot; takes analytic population objective, decay500/cap4000 from protocol.json
solver_selection_provenance.independent_confirmation: population_pilot and population_l2_pilot both used the actual exact empirical-population optimizer, decay500/cap4000, two held-out meta-validation cost tasks; same LR/L2 tuple confirmed before production
solver_selection_provenance.report_instruction: Do not describe the stochastic v3 schedule as production or as a convergence-certified bank solver; preserve actual saved settings.
